decisions.reason: The candidate already uses the latest reference script as its foundation. Combining benefits from two scripts changes messaging content but does not necessarily change the current creative direction.
The source changes the reference and benefit sources for messaging, not the requirement that the script and preview be in Hindi.
The source does not change the 28–54 audience range or Indian-market context.
Using the latest reference as a messaging model does not necessarily remove or alter the testimonial presentation or independently created testimonial material.
The source does not discuss or change the integrated call-to-action.
The revised messaging basis remains compatible with the existing viral-style requirement and does not change its value.
The source does not specify a new hook structure, directness rule, or market-alignment value.
The messaging-source change has no necessary effect on lip-sync accuracy or facial-expression requirements.
The source does not change responsibility for creating the script, sourcing visuals, or producing voiceover.
The source concerns script messaging and does not resolve or alter the production-method conflict about live-action and AI-generated visuals.
The source does not change the CPL target, conversion objective, or priority of conversion performance over aesthetics.
The messaging revision does not change video duration, formats, pilot quantity, or follow-on order conditions.
